title: 海外培训总监
description:
Key Responsibilities
Build the overseas store training framework, covering operational skills, leadership development, certification systems, and career progression pathways.
Develop annual training plans, budgets, and KPIs, and drive training initiatives that enhance store operational performance.
Establish a structured talent pipeline from frontline staff → store manager → area/region management to ensure sufficient leadership bench strength.
Lead and manage the internal training team, ensuring standardized, scalable, and impactful training content delivery across markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, HR, and Brand/Marketing to gather business needs and complete feedback loops.
Monitor and evaluate training impact through metrics such as learning completion rate, certification pass rate, and improvements in store operational indicators to verify training ROI.
Develop and implement digital learning tools and platforms (systems, assessments, question banks, certification modules) to improve global learning efficiency.
Qualifications
Experience in curriculum development or training within the F&B or retail industry preferred.
Strong drive for results, growth mindset, and leadership potential.
Solid understanding of store-level training systems or talent development frameworks in the restaurant/retail sector.
Strong cross-cultural communication skills; experience in overseas markets is a plus.
Fluent in both Chinese and English for daily work communication.
Experience building a 0-to-1 training system for overseas markets is a strong advantage.

title: Regional Store Operations Supervisor
description:
Job Overview:
The Regional Store Operations Supervisor will oversee and manage the operations of multiple
Heytea stores within a specified region, ensuring operational excellence, team development, and
brand consistency. This role focuses on both new store launches and the continuous
improvement of existing stores. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in multi-unit
management, demonstrated leadership abilities, and the drive to deliver exceptional customer
service and business outcomes. We are looking for a dynamic individual with experience in
fast-paced retail or food service environments who is adaptable to the evolving needs of our
growing brand.

Key Responsibilities:
Store Opening and Expansion:
Collaborate with business partners to support team recruitment, onboarding, and training.
Participate in the planning and preparation of new store openings, including operational testing
and compliance checks.
Ensure smooth and timely execution of new store launches, adhering to all regulatory
requirements.
Store Standardization and Compliance:
Conduct regular audits of stores to ensure compliance with Heytea's brand standards and local
regulatory requirements, including health, safety, and labor laws.
Provide support to stores in managing inventory and equipment, tracking stock levels, and
ensuring operational efficiency.
Guide store teams in product merchandising and presentation, conducting regular performance
assessments to ensure brand alignment.
Store Performance Optimization:
Collaborate with store managers to track and enhance sales performance, operational efficiency,
and customer satisfaction.
Assist in implementing and overseeing employee performance reviews and professional
development plans to meet company objectives.
Monitor and elevate customer service levels, ensuring the delivery of Heytea's signature
customer experience across all stores.
Team Development and Talent Management:
Work with partners and store managers to build effective team structures, establishing clear roles, responsibilities, and career development pathways.
Provide ongoing training and mentorship to store managers and team members, promoting
professional growth and operational excellence.
Facilitate leadership development programs and succession planning to ensure a pipeline of
qualified talent for future expansion.
New Supervisor Onboarding and Development:
Support the onboarding and training of new Regional Supervisors, providing them with the tools
and knowledge needed to manage their assigned stores effectively.
Collaborate with the broader operations team to continuously improve training programs and
operational processes.

Qualifications:
Industry and Operational Experience:
A minimum of 3 years of experience in multi-unit management, preferably in the food and
beverage industry, with expertise in store operations, sales strategies, inventory control, and
team leadership.
Proven ability to manage and optimize the operations of multiple store locations simultaneously,
driving both top-line growth and operational efficiency.
Cross-Cultural and International Experience:
Experience working in or managing operations in international markets is preferred, with a deep
understanding of cultural diversity and the ability to adapt strategies to different regional
markets.
Strong knowledge of U.S. labor laws, health and safety regulations, and employment standards,
with experience ensuring compliance across multiple locations.
Leadership and Problem-Solving Skills:
Exceptional problem-solving abilities, with a track record of independently addressing
operational challenges and driving business results.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively manage relationships with store
managers, team members, and business partners.
Demonstrated leadership in fostering team collaboration, motivation, and alignment with
company goals.
Talent Development and Coaching:
Experience in talent management, including team building, coaching, and developing
high-performing store managers and staff.
Strong ability to mentor new leaders and provide guidance in operational best practices, ensuring
that teams are aligned with the company’s vision and values.
Additional Requirements:
Proficiency in financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance
monitoring.
Flexibility to travel frequently within the region (California and New York).
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to the changing needs of a growing
business.

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Heytea is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating
an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for
employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual
orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status, in compliance with
applicable federal, state, and local laws.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Brand Visual Design
Lead visual design projects for HEYTEA's North America market, including new product launches, packaging, collaborations, campaigns, key visuals, in-store materials, and other brand touch points.
Participate in the full creative process, from early concepts and creative direction to design development and final execution.
Develop a strong understanding of HEYTEA's brand identity and visual language, while bringing insights from North American culture, lifestyles, and aesthetics into the work.
Think beyond individual design pieces and explore how creative concepts can be effectively extended across different formats, materials, channels, and consumer touch points.
2. Creative & Design
Bring strong visual taste and creative thinking, with the ability to independently develop and execute design concepts.
Stay curious about areas beyond design, including art, culture, fashion, lifestyle, and the world around you.
Have your own perspective on branding and design. Go beyond simply executing briefs and actively contribute to discussions around why we are doing something, how we should approach it, and what other possibilities exist .
Stay sensitive to emerging design trends and visual expressions, while maintaining your own judgment rather than simply following trends.
3. Project Ownership & Execution
Independently own projects from brief and creative exploration through design development and final execution.
Take initiative and drive projects forward once the direction is established, without relying on detailed instructions at every step.
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product, Operations, Supply Chain, and external creative partners to bring ideas to life.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize time and resources effectively.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor’s degree or above in Visual Communication, Graphic Design, Brand Design, or a related field is preferred.
Experience
3–5+ years of experience in brand, visual, or graphic design , preferably within consumer brands, F&B, retail, lifestyle, or other consumer-facing industries.
Experience participating in or building a brand’s visual identity from 0 to 1 is highly preferred.
Proven experience independently owning and delivering complete design projects from concept to execution.
Currently based in New York .
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Fluent in both Chinese and English , with the ability to use both as working languages.
What We’re Looking For
Strong visual fundamentals and a thoughtful understanding of typography, layout, graphics, and brand design.
A strong sense of aesthetics and sensitivity to quality and visual details.
Curious about culture, art, fashion, lifestyle, and the world around you.
Someone with your own ideas and perspectives, who is also open to discussion, experimentation, iteration, and challenging existing ideas.
A self-driven designer who can balance creative thinking with strong execution and project ownership.

title: Beverage R&D Manager (Bubble Tea )
description:
Job Responsibilities
As a Beverage R&D Manager, you will be responsible for leading the development and innovation of beverage products. Your primary focus will be on leveraging your expertise in food research and development to enhance our beverage offerings. Key responsibilities include:

Conducting in-depth analysis of food ingredients with a strong emphasis on understanding beverage formulations.
Exploring and comprehending the beverage consumption market in the United States, with a particular focus on local trends and preferences.
Performing competitive analysis to identify market trends, potential opportunities, and areas for product differentiation.
Leading the end-to-end process of beverage product development, from ideation to commercialization.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of R&D efforts with other departments, such as marketing and production.
Spearheading product innovation initiatives to enhance our beverage portfolio and maintain a competitive edge in the market.

To succeed in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:

A background in food research and development, with a focus on beverages.
In-depth knowledge of food ingredients and their applications in beverage formulations.
Familiarity with the American beverage consumption market, coupled with the ability to conduct effective competitor analyses.
Proven experience in developing and launching successful beverage products.
Proficiency in both English and Chinese, enabling effective communication with international teams.
Willingness to travel between China and the United States for business purposes.
Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate and lead cross-functional teams.

工作职责：
理解并执行公司开店目标
协助合作伙伴完成团队组建及培训。参与新店筹备并提供支持，包括压力测试和验收。支持新店开业运营相关工作，确保顺利开店。
校准区域门店标准：
完成区域内门店标准化的核查与调整，确保品牌统一性。协助门店完成相关物料和设备管理，追踪库存管理情况。指导门店进行产品和陈列标准的优化，并进行巡店考评。
提升既有门店的经营管理水平：
追踪并提升门店销售业绩，协助门店提升经营管理水平，落实门店的绩效考核。协助门店提升客户服务、运营效率和员工的职业素养，推动整体管理水平。
协助合伙人完成梯队搭建与人才培养：
辅导合伙人团队的人员管理与梯队培养，制定清晰的晋升路径。提供员工培训支持，协助门店提升运营水平，并为新晋管理层提供带训和监督。
参与带训新督导岗位：
参与新督导的带训工作，讲解督导岗位的角色与职责，帮助新督导尽快进入角色。提升新督导的运营标准化能力，推动新督导团队的整体成长。

任职资格：
行业经验：
具备 3 年以上大型茶饮或餐饮加盟品牌督导/店经理工作经验，能独立负责多家门店的运营和管理。
海外工作经验：
了解海外市场和文化，具备在海外工作或管理的经验。熟悉并掌握营运管理、销售策略、订货管理等方面的知识和实践经验。
沟通与领导力：
具备较强的独立解决问题能力，能够在压力下完成任务。具有亲和力和良好的协调沟通能力，能够与团队保持良好合作关系，提升团队士气。
培训与辅导能力：
具备梯队搭建和人才培养的经验，能够为合伙人和门店团队提供指导和支持，推动团队成长。

title: Warehouse Specialist/Supervisor
description:
About HeyTea
HeyTea is a leading global new-style tea brand, operating company-owned stores and a growing franchise network across the U.S. Our Supply Chain team ensures the timely, accurate, and compliant flow of goods from vendors and central warehouses to our stores, supporting rapid business growth across California, New York, and beyond.

Position Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Warehouse & Transportation professional to join our Supply Chain team in Irvine, CA. This role is responsible for coordinating warehouse operations and transportation logistics to ensure accurate, on-time delivery of goods to company-owned and franchise stores. Depending on the candidate's experience, this position may be hired at the Specialist or Supervisor level.

Key Responsibilities
Coordinate daily warehouse operations, including receiving, inventory put-away, order picking/packing, and outbound shipment preparation, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
Plan, schedule, and monitor inbound and outbound transportation to ensure on-time, cost-effective delivery to stores and distribution points across California and other regions.
Coordinate with third-party carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics vendors; track shipments and proactively resolve delays, discrepancies, or damage claims.
Maintain accurate inventory records and conduct regular cycle counts; investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies in coordination with the warehouse and store teams.
Support demand and replenishment planning by monitoring store-level stock levels and coordinating timely restocking of key ingredients and materials.
Ensure warehouse operations comply with applicable food safety, safety, and California labor and workplace regulations (e.g., OSHA, cold-chain handling where applicable).
Prepare and maintain shipment, inventory, and cost reports for management review; identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce logistics costs.
(Supervisor level) Provide day-to-day guidance and work direction to warehouse staff; assist with scheduling, training, and performance feedback.
Serve as a liaison between the Irvine office, warehouse operations, stores, and headquarters, communicating updates clearly in both English and Chinese as needed.
Complete work reports and other assigned tasks based on the needs of the company and management.
Conduct regular warehouse walkthroughs/inspections, including shelf-life and expiration date management of inventory.

Qualifications
2–3 years of experience in warehouse operations and/or transportation/logistics management, ideally within food & beverage, retail, or CPG supply chain environments.
Bilingual proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English (written and verbal) required, to support communication with headquarters and local stakeholders.
Working knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS), transportation management systems (TMS), or ERP platforms; proficiency in Excel.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments, vendors, and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of inventory control principles and cost/expense tracking related to logistics operations.
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
(Supervisor level) Prior experience directly guiding or overseeing warehouse staff preferred.
Valid driver's license; ability to occasionally travel between Irvine office, warehouse, and store locations within California.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements
This role is based in our Irvine office with regular on-site visits to warehouse and store locations. Warehouse visits may require standing, walking, and occasionally lifting up to 25–40 lbs.
